solution.approach: Official Answer: Option B (**3**).
solution.keyConcept: Individual Remainder Multiplication: Rem(A×B ÷ D) = Rem(r_A × r_B ÷ D)
solution.en:
Method 1: Direct Multiply & Divide: $171 \times 173 = 29583$. Divide by `17`: $17 \times 1740 = 29580$, remainder $= 29583 - 29580 = \mathbf{3}$.

Method 2: Remainder Theorem (`2 sec`): Since $170 = 17 \times 10$, $171 \equiv \mathbf{1} \pmod{17}$ and $173 \equiv \mathbf{3} \pmod{17}$.
Product remainder $= 1 \times 3 = \mathbf{3}$!
